title: Shagged by a rare parrot | Last Chance To See - BBC
summary: A clip from BBC's Last Chance to See in which Stephen Fry and Mark Carwardine meet Sirocco, a kakapo, who famously tries to mate with Carwardine's head. The kakapo is a critically endangered flightless New Zealand parrot.
why: HN points to it as the origin of the Party Parrot emote and as the famous viral kakapo clip whenever kakapo come up.

quote.text: The video of that encounter is the origin of the Party Parrot emote which you might have seen on Slack.
